title: Scrapple and Crab Cakes
description:
Hello! Mike and I just got home from visiting my dad for the weekend. So it's back in the kitchen I go. First I have to wrap and freeze some scrapple that my dad sent with us. Mike will explain to you what this is. Then I am making some crab cakes for dinner.
